svg.title: Switch agents. Keep the work.
svg.desc: Save useful context in the shared project checkpoint. Continue in Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or another coding agent, one writer at a time. Logos identify Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode and Cline. See the README compatibility matrix for validation coverage.

g.text: Leave useful context in your project.
Continue in the next agent or session.
Either direction. One writer at a time.
ONE CHECKPOINT. YOUR CHOICE OF AGENT.
Host routes and validation: see Compatibility below.
